svg.title: End-to-End Architecture with a Feedback Loop
svg.desc: Main flow left to right: Input (ingestion and context assembly) to Processing (model call, tool loop or agent delegation) to Output (validation, guardrails and formatting) to Delivery (user or downstream system). Output also feeds the Feedback Loop (logging, eval, human review). The feedback loop sends retraining and prompt updates back to Processing, and corrections back to Input.
svg.text: End-to-End Architecture with a Feedback Loop
Four stages carry each request; the feedback loop is the return path that makes it production-grade.
